candidates.description: This vector represents active English verbs denoting various physical, mental, or relational actions and processes.
This vector represents linguistic roots, prefixes, and etymological fragments common to historical, institutional, and philosophical terminology across Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector activates for multi-digit numbers representing numerical values or numerical identifiers.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs and verb inflections related to actions and past tense occurrences.
This vector activates for words, roots, and sub-word tokens containing the letters "qu".
This feature vector activates on tokens related to the suffix "-able" or "-ible" and their morphological variations across different languages.
These tokens represent Spanish prepositions used to indicate spatial, temporal, or logical relationships.
These tokens represent Spanish demonstrative pronouns and adjectives, as well as common linguistic roots containing the "est" sequence.
This vector activates on words, roots, or suffixes starting with 'p' or related to Spanish-derived and Latinate verb stems.
This vector represents legal terminology, judicial concepts, and jurisprudence-related roots across multiple languages.
